title: Apple App Store App Details Scraper
description: Get Apple App Store app details with publisher, price, rating, privacy labels, version, and related apps. Batch product IDs with a storefront country to enrich app catalogs or compare listings.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Apple App Store Details | Product Data
storeCopy.seoDescription: Get Apple App Store details, ratings, privacy labels, and reviews by product ID. Enrich app catalogs and compare listings across storefronts.
storeCopy.intro: Look up Apple App Store apps and supported product types by product ID. Review listing facts, ratings, privacy labels, available reviews, and related products in one record.
useCases: App catalog teams can enrich product records with publisher, version, ratings, and privacy labels.
Market analysts can compare app pricing and popularity across storefronts.
App publishers can review how their listings appear beside similar products.
howToUse: Add one Apple product ID to `product_ids` for each supported product.
Choose store vertical and country for the target storefront.
Run the Actor and read one detailed item per product ID.

faqs.question: Which Apple product types can I look up?
faqs.answer: Set `store` to apps, Mac apps, books, audiobooks, movies, TV, music, or podcasts when supported.

fields.name: search_parameters
fields.description: Apple product ID, selected storefront country, and storefront type used for the app lookup.

fields.name: product
fields.description: App name, publisher, category, price, current version, privacy labels, and other product-page details.

fields.name: ratings
fields.description: Average star score, total rating count, and rating distribution reported for the app.

fields.name: similar
fields.description: Other App Store products Apple surfaces as similar to this app.

fields.name: more_by_developer
fields.description: Other App Store products listed by the same developer account.

fields.name: reviews
fields.description: Review records returned for this app, with written feedback and star ratings when available.

fields.name: reviews_pagination
fields.description: Review offsets, page size, and flags showing whether another review page is available.

fields.name: input_product_id
fields.description: Apple product ID submitted for this app details lookup.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this app record was collected.
